description: Canonical payment state machine, consumed by core/events/payment-state-machine.js at runtime and rendered into payment-lifecycle.md for humans. This file is the single source of truth for allowed transitions - do not hardcode transitions elsewhere.

transitions.trigger: scenario resolves to a failure reason
scenario timeout elapsed with no resolution

notes.retryBehavior: The runtime never transitions a payment on its own after a terminal state is reached. Retries apply only to callback delivery, not to the payment's canonical status.
notes.idempotency: Re-delivering a callback (duplicateCallback) re-sends the same eventId and does not re-run a transition; the payment's status is set once when the scenario resolves.
notes.providerLeakage: Provider-specific status values (e.g. an M-Pesa response code) must never appear as a canonical status. They are mapped in both directions by each provider's mappings/statuses.yaml.
